cashFlowCoverage.both-present: FCF and Capex both have values
cashFlowCoverage.fcf-missing-only: FCF is missing while Capex has a value
cashFlowCoverage.capex-missing-only: Capex is missing while FCF has a value
cashFlowCoverage.both-missing: FCF and Capex are both missing

capexDefinition.gross-productive-assets-cash-purchases: Primary-source-reviewed gross cash purchases of productive assets under SEC XBRL PaymentsToAcquireProductiveAssets; taxonomy scope includes PP&E, software, and other intangible assets
capexDefinition.gross-ppe-cash-purchases: Primary-source-reviewed gross cash purchases of PP&E, including SEC XBRL PaymentsToAcquirePropertyPlantAndEquipment
capexDefinition.gross-ppe: Gross/standard cash PP&E expenditure; no net, intangible, broader-asset, or real-estate qualifier detected
capexDefinition.ppe-plus-intangible: PP&E plus intangible assets or capitalized software/development
capexDefinition.broader-non-current-assets: A broader non-current/fixed/long-term asset cash-investment line
capexDefinition.net-capex: Capex or PP&E cash spending disclosed on a net basis
capexDefinition.not-collected: No Capex value is collected and no REIT/real-estate definition supersedes the missing classification
capexDefinition.unclassified: A value exists, but basis text does not safely map to another definition category

operatingProfitDefinition.ebit: Reported EBIT used as the operating-profit measure
operatingProfitDefinition.reconstructed-operating-income: Atlas reconstructs operating income from reported operating line items
operatingProfitDefinition.source-linked: Value is retained as source-linked rather than verified
operatingProfitDefinition.special-case: Missing, period-derived, or otherwise not safely classified as a direct reported measure

adjustedNonGaapFcfAssessment.atlas-formula-aligned: Adjusted/Non-GAAP label is present, but the disclosed formula is operating cash flow minus the same cash-Capex scope used by Atlas
adjustedNonGaapFcfAssessment.atlas-definition-difference: Adjusted/Non-GAAP FCF includes a definition difference such as sale proceeds, net Capex, incentives, or an additional scope component
adjustedNonGaapFcfAssessment.unresolved: Adjusted/Non-GAAP FCF is populated but basis text does not close the formula safely
adjustedNonGaapFcfAssessment.not-applicable: The record is not a populated company-reported adjusted/Non-GAAP FCF

specialFlags.goodwill-impairment: Reported result includes or discusses goodwill impairment
specialFlags.net-basis-capex: Capex is disclosed on a net basis
specialFlags.broad-capex: Capex uses a broader non-current-asset definition
specialFlags.ppe-only: Cash Capex is limited to PP&E and excludes separately classified intangible-asset purchases
specialFlags.government-incentive-netting-unresolved: Company policy permits government incentives to be netted against PP&E additions, but the period-specific netting amount is not disclosed; the source-verified value is retained while Atlas gross cash Capex remains unresolved
specialFlags.company-fcf-formula-includes-asset-sale-: Company FCF formula adds PP&E sale proceeds; the reviewed period has zero proceeds, so the stored Atlas value is unaffected
specialFlags.company-reported-fcf: FCF value comes from a company-reported measure
specialFlags.non-gaap-fcf-atlas-formula-aligned: Adjusted/Non-GAAP wording is present, but the disclosed formula matches Atlas FCF scope
specialFlags.fcf-atlas-definition-difference: FCF uses a definition that differs from Atlas gross cash-Capex normalization
specialFlags.adjusted-or-non-gaap-fcf-unresolved: Adjusted/Non-GAAP FCF formula cannot be closed from current basis text
specialFlags.cash-flow-inputs-missing: A populated FCF record does not have complete cashFlowInputs
specialFlags.fcf-capex-scope-mismatch: The populated FCF subtracts a cash-investment component outside the stored Capex value's scope
specialFlags.derived-single-quarter: A single-quarter value is derived from cumulative periods
specialFlags.unclassified-capex-definition: A populated Capex value remains definition-unclassified
specialFlags.special-operating-profit-definition: Operating-profit definition is classified as a special case
